name: leavecode-platform
description: LeaveCode enterprise monorepo - Next.js frontend, Express backend, and shared TypeScript schemas

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['node_modules', 'apps/frontend/.next', 'apps/frontend/node_modules', 'apps/backend/dist', 'apps/backend/node_modules', 'packages/shared/dist', 'packages/shared/node_modules'].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); });"
